records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Your cancellation timing question
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for raising this, and sorry for the wait on your open ticket. To confirm the timing point: a cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle, not immediately, so you keep the days already paid for. A colleague is following up on the ticket itself.

In the meantime, if it would help, I'm glad to walk through one next step with you on a short call this week 
creating or organizing a project, or getting your invited teammate in 
so the remaining days are useful either way.

Best,
Nadia
